name: DINWEY Battery Master Data
description: Single source of truth for DINWEY heavy-duty truck starting battery specifications across JIS, DIN and BCI standards. Manufacturer: Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd.

dataProvenance.method: First-party manufacturer specification (DINWEY datasheet and published product pages), cross-referenced against independent industry fitment guides and third-party battery catalogs where available.
dataProvenance.verificationPolicy: Fields not published by the manufacturer are left null and marked 'unverified'. Ratings are never interpolated or assumed. Specifications vary by manufacturer — always confirm against the specific vehicle.

sourceTiers.tier1: Manufacturer datasheet, standards organizations (JIS D5301, EN 50342-1, SAE J537)
sourceTiers.tier2: Independent commercial-vehicle fitment guides (Club Assist, Century Batteries)
sourceTiers.tier3: Third-party battery catalogs (Bosch, Yuasa, SSB, Powsea)

fieldDefinitions.case_size: Case-size designation used for tray fitment
fieldDefinitions.cca_standard: Standard the CCA rating is measured to
fieldDefinitions.rc_standard: Standard the reserve capacity is measured to
fieldDefinitions.weight_kg: Battery weight in kg (null = not published by manufacturer)
fieldDefinitions.truck_brand: Truck brands commonly using this size (reference only)

models.application: Large trucks, buses, diesel generators, off-highway and construction equipment
models.vehicle_type: Heavy trucks, semi trailers, buses and coaches, diesel generators
models.truck_brand: Hino 700 Series, Volvo FH/FM (up to 2013), Scania R Series (2005–2014), MAN TGS/TGX (N150L standard)
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets Asia, Middle East, Africa
models.source: DINWEY manufacturer specification (first-party) + cross-reference Club Assist / Century Batteries fitment guides
models.notes: Dimensions, CCA and RC are DINWEY's first-party figures. Independent catalogs list N150 at 500–510mm length and 210–257mm height with CCA 750–1100 depending on manufacturer — confirm exact tray dimensions and rating before replacement. Weight not published by manufacturer.

models.application: Largest heavy-duty trucks, long-haul semi trailers, cold-climate starting, prime diesel generators
models.vehicle_type: Heavy trucks, long-haul semi trailers, buses and coaches, diesel generators
models.truck_brand: Volvo FH/FM (2014-on), Scania R Series (2015-on Euro VI), MAN TGS/TGX (heavy-duty 273mm option)
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets Asia, Middle East, Africa
models.source: DINWEY manufacturer specification (first-party) + cross-reference Club Assist / Century Batteries fitment guides
models.notes: Independent catalogs list N200 at ~521–523×278–279×240–248mm with CCA up to ~1130 depending on manufacturer. DINWEY's 520×278×220mm and 1100A are first-party figures. Confirm tray dimensions before upgrading from N150. Weight not published by manufacturer.

models.application: European commercial trucks, buses and coaches, cold-climate starting, Middle East and North Africa markets
models.truck_brand: MAN, Scania, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, DAF
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets Europe, Middle East, North Africa
models.notes: DIN88 is a length-based size class (353mm case). EN cold-cranking (800A) is measured to EN 50342-1 and is NOT directly comparable to JIS CCA or SAE CCA. Weight not published by manufacturer.

models.application: Larger European commercial trucks, buses and coaches, high electrical loads, Middle East and North Africa markets
models.truck_brand: MAN, Scania, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, DAF
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets Europe, Middle East, North Africa
models.notes: DIN100 is 40mm longer than DIN88 (393mm vs 353mm) with identical 175mm width and 190mm height. EN cold-cranking (870A) is measured to EN 50342-1 — not directly comparable to JIS/SAE CCA. Weight not published by manufacturer.

models.application: North American Class 7–8 trucks, off-highway equipment, Latin American heavy vehicles
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets North America, Latin America
models.source: DINWEY made-to-order BCI line (no published stock specification)
models.notes: Made-to-order — no shelf stock. Exact CCA, capacity, dimensions, terminal type and polarity are confirmed on inquiry. Reference only: BCI Group 31 is nominally 330×173×240mm with SAE J537 CCA; do not treat as DINWEY rating.
